changelog: `apm install <pkg>` also locks declared local-path dependencies missing from `apm.lock.yaml`, and reports byte-identical pre-existing skills as adopted (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: apm install <pkg> after apm init --discover --apply left the declared local dependency out of apm.lock.yaml and reported an identical pre-existing skill as integrated instead of adopted.

owner: src/apm_cli/install/package_selection.py (unlocked_local_dependencies; selected_subtree_dependencies unchanged) used by install/phases/resolve.py _include_unlocked_local_dependencies after _apply_only_filter + src/apm_cli/integration/skill_integrator.py (_promote_sub_skills records adoption; SkillIntegrationResult.sub_skills_adopted) + src/apm_cli/install/services.py (_sub_skill_phrase)
notes: Lock part: a partial install (apm install <pkg>) filtered the resolved graph to the named subtree, so a declared direct local-path dependency that no lock row recorded was resolved but never integrated or locked; with --target claude its source under .claude/skills/ is its own deployment path, so the files sat in a target root unclaimed (I1). The requested selection (selected_subtree_dependencies) is unchanged, so the apm install <pkg> --dry-run preview still counts only the requested subtree (integrator follow-up: tests/unit/test_install_command.py::TestInstallCommandAutoBootstrap::test_positional_dry_run_excludes_unrequested_manifest_dependencies passes). The real install path then adds, via package_selection.unlocked_local_dependencies, direct local deps whose key is missing from the existing lock (all of them when there is no lock), with their subtrees. dry_run_plan.py is back to its main-branch text. Locked local deps and remote deps keep the old partial-install behaviour. Reporting part: sub-skill promotion now records skills whose unowned pre-existing copy was byte-identical (adopted) and install prints 'N skill(s) adopted' / 'N skill(s) integrated (M adopted)', matching the per-kind lines. Native single-skill packages keep their existing wording. Docs: reference/cli/install.md and apm-guide commands.md. Unit test tests/unit/test_drift_detection.py::test_locked_copy_proof_lets_a_readable_git_head_decide fails in this environment on main too (gpg commit signing via env git config), unrelated. I used git stash twice early in this bug before the shared-stash warning; verified afterwards that the worktree holds only my changes and the stash list is empty. PR #4138 touches install/phases/resolve.py: small textual conflict risk around run() and _apply_only_filter. Pre-existing failures on base 7a241c409 (unrelated, verified by running them against base source): tests/integration/test_integrators_end_to_end.py::TestSkillIntegratorSyncIntegration::test_removes_managed_skill_dir and tests/integration/test_skipped_integration_preserves_deployments.py::test_skipped_integration_preserves_prior_files_and_lock_claims.
